Container.Name: Releasomat
Container.Overview: Turns playlists from ListenBrainz, Apple Music, Deezer, Tidal, YouTube (Music), SoundCloud and Beatport into playlists in your Navidrome. Releasomat links the songs you already have, downloads the missing ones via yt-dlp or Soulseek (slskd) into its own folder inside your music library, and keeps every playlist up to date on its own schedule. It only ever touches the files it downloaded itself. Early development: not ready for use yet.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for the web interface.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Database, settings and yt-dlp's cookies.txt. Keep appdata on a pool (exclusive share) so SQLite works reliably.

Config.Name: Releasomat Music Folder
Config.Description: Releasomat's OWN folder inside the music library Navidrome scans, e.g. /mnt/user/media/music/Releasomat. Downloads are saved here, and Releasomat writes nowhere else. Map only this subfolder, not your whole library: Releasomat finds the songs you already have through Navidrome.

Config.Name: slskd Downloads
Config.Description: Optional. slskd's download folder (the one slskd maps to its /app/downloads), so Releasomat can move finished Soulseek downloads it started into its music folder.

Config.Name: Navidrome URL
Config.Description: Optional (can be set in the web UI instead; set here, the UI shows it read-only). Navidrome's address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:4533 (your server's IP), or http://navidrome:4533 on a shared custom Docker network. Not localhost.

Config.Name: Navidrome User
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). A Navidrome user with admin rights.

Config.Name: Navidrome Password
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). That user's password. Sent to Navidrome only as a salted token.

Config.Name: Navidrome Subfolder
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default Releasomat). The name of Releasomat's music folder as Navidrome sees it inside its library.

Config.Name: Download Sources
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default slskd,youtube). The download sources tried for every playlist, in order, comma-separated: slskd (Soulseek), youtube. none: only link songs already in Navidrome. A source that isn't connected is skipped.

Config.Name: slskd URL
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). slskd's address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:5030. Not localhost.

Config.Name: slskd API Key
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). An API key from slskd's settings.

Config.Name: Soulseek Formats
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default flac,aiff,wav,mp3). The file types taken from Soulseek, best first, comma-separated: flac, aiff, wav, mp3, m4a, ogg, opus. A track with none of them goes to the next download source.

Config.Name: Soulseek Minimum Bitrate
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default 320). The lowest bitrate in kbit/s (128-320) for lossy files from Soulseek (mp3, m4a, ogg, opus). Lossless files always pass.

Config.Name: ListenBrainz User
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). Your ListenBrainz user name, for the Created for you playlists.

Config.Name: ListenBrainz Token
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). Your user token from listenbrainz.org, Settings.

Config.Name: Tidal Client ID
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). From a free app on developer.tidal.com, only for Tidal playlists.

Config.Name: Tidal Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI). That app's client secret.

Config.Name: Download Concurrency
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default 2). How many downloads run at the same time, for all playlists together.

Config.Name: Match Threshold
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default 85). How similar (50-100) a found song must be to count as the same track.

Config.Name: Path Template
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default {artist}/{artist} - {title}.{ext}). File names inside the music folder. Placeholders: {artist}, {title}, {album}, {ext}.

Config.Name: Delete Old Snapshot Playlists
Config.Description: Optional (or in the web UI; default false). true: for playlists in snapshot mode, Releasomat keeps the newest N snapshot playlists in Navidrome and deletes older ones it created itself. false: old snapshot playlists stay until you delete them. Music files are never deleted.

Config.Name: Log Level
Config.Description: How much Releasomat writes to the container log: DEBUG, INFO, WARNING or ERROR.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the app runs as (Unraid default 99 = nobody). With Soulseek: the same as your slskd container, so Releasomat can pick up its downloads.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the app runs as (Unraid default 100 = users). With Soulseek: the same as your slskd container.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permission mask for newly created files.
